title_sq: Shesim Apartment 1+1 ne rezidencen prestigioze "UNICO", Bllok!
description_sq:
Ne zemer te Tiranes, ne nje nga zonat me elitare dhe me te kerkuara te qytetit - Blloku, ofrohet per shitje apartment 1+1 ne rezidencen prestigjoze UNICO, e pozicionuar ne Rrugen Nikolle Tupe.
Rezidenca UNICO ishte nje godine moderne banimi dhe sherbimi 11-katëshe, me 4 kate parkimi nentokesor, e konceptuar sipas standardeve me te larta arkitektonike dhe urbane, duke nderthurur funksionalitetin, estetiken dhe cilesine superiore te ndërtimit.
Detaje te prones:
* Tipologjia: 1+1
* Kati: 4
* Orientimi: Lindje
* Siperfaqe neto: 55.1 m2
* Sipërfaqe e perbashket: 8.3 m2
* Siperfage bruto: 63.4 m2
*Planimetri e rregullt
*3 Ashensore total
Organizimi i apartamentit: Sallon dhe kend gatimi, dhome gjumi dhe tualet.
Apartmenti ndodhet ne nje lokacion premium, me akses te menjehershem ne sherbime, institucione, bare, restorante dhe qendrat kryesore te biznesit te Tiranes, duke e bere nje zgjedhje ideale si per banim ashtu edhe per investim.
Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 1+1 for sale in the prestigious "UNICO" residence, Block!
description_en: In the heart of Tirana, in one of the most elite and sought-after areas of the city - Blloku, a 1+1 apartment is offered for sale in the prestigious UNICO residence, located on Nikolle Tupe Street. The UNICO residence was a modern 11-story residential and service building, with 4 underground parking floors, conceived according to the highest architectural and urban standards, combining functionality, aesthetics and superior construction quality. Property details: * Typology: 1+1 * Floor: 4 * Orientation: East * Net area: 55.1 m2 * Common area: 8.3 m2 * Gross area: 63.4 m2 * Regular floor plan * 3 total elevators Organization of the apartment: Living room and kitchenette, bedroom and bathroom. The apartment is located in a premium location, with immediate access to services, institutions, bars, restaurants and the main business centers of Tirana, making it an ideal choice for both residence and investment. For a visit to the property, contact me!
